title: Dak Nong geopark in two days
summary: Truc Lam Dao Nguyen north of Gia Nghia on the first day, and Dray Sap on the Serepok on the second.

days.title: Day 1 — Truc Lam Dao Nguyen
days.body: The pine-forest monastery on TL 686 in Nâm N'Jang, Dak Song, about 39 km or about 40 km north of Gia Nghia. Entry is free. Time on the grounds and the ride from town are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 2 — Dray Sap
days.body: The Serepok cascade in Dak Sor, Krong No, about 110 km from Gia Nghia and about 100 metres wide. Keep this day for the fall. The gate price and the time on the paths are Check on arrival.

stops.name: Truc Lam Dao Nguyen
stops.note: The pine-forest halls about 39 km or about 40 km north of Gia Nghia.

stops.name: Dray Sap Waterfall
stops.note: The Serepok cascade in Dak Sor, about 110 km from Gia Nghia.

additions.name: Dak Nong coffee
additions.note: Robusta, Arabica, and Culi grown on the basalt around Gia Nghia.

seoTitle: Dak Nong in two days — Truc Lam and Dray Sap
seoDescription: Two days from Gia Nghia: Truc Lam Dao Nguyen to the north, then Dray Sap about 110 km away on the Serepok.
